_source: site/app/globals.css @theme block (Tailwind v4 is CSS-first, so that block IS the config — there is no tailwind.config.js). Values cross-checked against getComputedStyle on a running page, not read off a screenshot. The canonical palette for the product is mobile/src/constants/Colors.ts; globals.css mirrors it.

accent.use: category accent and the tint inside the card shadow
accent.note: Declared in globals.css but tree-shaken out of the served custom properties because no utility class uses it directly. It survives in --shadow-card, which the browser serves as #f5388f1a — that is this hex at 10% alpha, which is how the value was confirmed.

accentSoft.use: accent fills, inactive chips, top of the hero gradient

surface.note: Plain white — there is no named surface token. Taken from a live card's computed background, not assumed.

text.use: headings and primary text — a near-black plum, not pure black

display.stack: Fredoka, 'Fredoka Fallback Metrics', ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif

typography._note: Only these five weight files are loaded — latin subset, normal style, woff2. No italics are loaded, so italic text renders synthetically; set headlines in 500 or 600 and body in 400, 500 or 700 to match the site exactly.
typography._fallbackMetrics: Fredoka falls back to Arial re-metricked by an @font-face in globals.css (ascent 95.64%, descent 23.17%, line-gap 0%, size-adjust 101.84%), which keeps the layout from shifting while the font loads.

pill.use: buttons, chips, badges — written inline as rounded-[999px], not a named token

card.note: A pink-tinted lift, not a grey one — the tint is the accent colour.

_colourScheme: Light only, by design. There is no dark theme in the product (UI-STYLE-GUIDE.md), so promo graphics should not invent one.
